def: a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth)

words.word: and if there be in the bald head
inward whether it be bare within

occurrences.text: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
words: And if there be in the bald head

occurrences.text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
words: inward whether it be bare within
